text.tspan: Evolution · A² A2/A3 · search role collaboration

1 generate(program) → 2 execute(program) → 3 measure(fitness) → 4 rank(candidate) → 5 breed(next) → 6 archive(best)
Evidence: 3/41 repositories, 3/36 families; 3 trajectories (2 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: AlphaEvolve-like search, evolutionary archive, program mutation, and fitness gates.
Negative control: Prompt-level variation with no executable search is not E07.
